formats.key: deposit(address token, uint256 amount, uint256 l2Recipient)
effects: Takes `amount` of `token` (STRK here) from the signer into the bridge, using the allowance the signer gave the bridge.
Takes all of msg.value in ETH from the signer as the L1→L2 message fee. The bridge sends it on to the Starknet core contract (0xc662…c8c4 in the trace).
Credits the bridged tokens to the Starknet address `l2Recipient` on L2. The signer gets nothing on L1.
formats.shown: Intent "Bridge", with the STRK amount, the Starknet recipient as a decimal integer, and the ETH deposit fee.

findings.title: deposit shows the Starknet recipient as a long decimal integer labelled only "Recipient".
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit field {"path":"l2Recipient","label":"Recipient","format":"raw"}; case 0 screen Recipient = "2616435859392095438933830530918590163965998318332799566221709688513359830273". Starknet wallets show this address as hex 0x05c8d9a7…dd01. The blind reader could not tell if it was their own address.
findings.fix: Change the label to "Starknet recipient" so the signer knows this is an L2 address and not an Ethereum one.

findings.title: deposit cannot show l2Recipient as a hex Starknet address: ERC-7730 has no hex or Starknet format for uint256.
findings.evidence: l2Recipient is uint256 in the deposit signature. The spec's hex rendering applies only to byte arrays (specs/erc-7730.md line 1449), so `raw` shows it in decimal.
findings.fix: This needs a spec format for non-EVM addresses or a hex rendering of integers.

findings.title: deposit intent "Bridge" names neither the destination network (Starknet) nor what is bridged.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit "intent": "Bridge", with no interpolatedIntent. Case 0 reader listed "Which network I am sending from and to" as unsure.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Bridge to Starknet" and add an interpolatedIntent such as "Bridge {amount} to Starknet".

cases.notes: 980000 STRK out (the transferFrom spent the allowance to 0) matches 'Amount to deposit'. 0.000022148627586501 ETH out matches 'Deposit fee'; the bridge sent all of it to the Starknet core contract. The reader could not check the decimal recipient.

couldNotCheck: The deposit code is not in the directory. 0xce5485…c7a4 is a StarkWare Proxy whose fallback delegatecalls the address in IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT. meta.json reports proxyResolution isProxy=false with no implementations, so the bridge implementation behind deposit() is missing. I could not check from code how amount, msg.value (including the native-ETH token path) and l2Recipient are used. Mined case 0 confirms only the STRK path.
